claim_tested: Does auxiliary future prediction improve measured recovery after an execution error?
reported_outcome: LIBERO averages 62.8 to 67.2 without chunking; 76.6 to 78.1 with chunking and mask.
baseline: Matched ablation configurations for auxiliary prediction; no controlled recovery comparator
notes: Qualitative re-grasping is illustrated; no recovery-conditioned estimate. Attention-mask effect is a separate contrast.

claim_tested: Does model-based planning improve measured recovery after an execution error?
reported_outcome: 12.5-point average completion-score gain across two ALOHA tasks.
baseline: Same task evaluations; refinement data and planning change together
attribution_level: Refined planning package, not isolated recovery or search
notes: Direct for narrow package-level completion claim. Challenging initial states are not a controlled mid-execution recovery intervention.

claim_tested: Does learned-world practice transfer to physical held-out tasks?
reported_outcome: SIMPLER to World-Gymnast: open34 to58; close74 to62; blue32 to72; yellow40 to78 percent.
baseline: Partially matched packages; training-task support and reward construction differ
attribution_level: Package-level transfer; not isolated distribution-shift mechanism
notes: Ten trials repeated five times; Table1 reports SE. Preserve the adverse close-drawer result.

claim_tested: Do distractor/instruction training extensions improve learned-environment performance?
reported_outcome: Table3 compares base and augmented variants; evaluations occur in WorldGym.
baseline: Policy variants share base method; additional training support differs
notes: Do not combine these outcomes with the physical Table1 as real-robot robustness evidence.

claim_tested: Does the13.1-to38.3 comparison isolate synthetic trajectory augmentation?

source_locator: Generalization to novel behaviors using Neural Trajectories; Discussion

claim_tested: Does the reported pretraining/adaptation scale quantify robot hours replaced by passive video?
reported_outcome: Action-free video pretraining is followed by robot adaptation and physical evaluation.
baseline: No matched robot-hours replacement contrast extracted
attribution_level: Cross-stage data provenance, not sample-efficiency attribution
notes: Different supervision populations cannot be converted into a common efficiency ratio.

claim_tested: Do generator realism scores establish physical grounding of VLA control?
evaluation_domain: Physical-scene videos; no robot policy execution
baseline: Generator benchmark with real-video reference; no VLA control comparator
attribution_level: Cross-model association in a different domain
notes: Nonsignificance does not establish no association. MLLM distinguishability has inverse realism direction; background source.

claim_tested: Does the Ctrl-World evaluation pipeline preserve physical policy rankings?

baseline: Same policy ranking target;20 physical rollouts per policy/environment
attribution_level: Evaluator validation, not world-model architecture ablation
notes: Keep human scoring and the tested implementation in scope; not evidence all learned evaluators fail.

claim_tested: Does task-value prediction provide calibrated constraint-violation or irreversibility estimates?
reported_outcome: No calibrated-safety or controlled irreversibility outcome extracted.

notes: Physical task completion is not safety evidence; this row must not count as an empirical safety study.
